author: KEXP
description: Michigan-based band Racing Mount Pleasant offer a blend of dynamic post-rock and intimate Midwest emo in our latest in-studio session. With host DJ Cheryl Waters, they share a performance of "Call It Easy" and more.
title: Racing Mount Pleasant performs "Call It Easy" & more Live on KEXP
